metadata.Name: MultiFilterOutput
metadata.Description: Splits application output into tabs by text/regex patterns.
LongDescription: Splits a running application's console output into separate tabs by user-defined text or regex patterns, so you can watch just the `ERROR` lines, just one subsystem's logging, or everything except the noisy `DEBUG` chatter, without losing the full unfiltered log.
- **Pattern Library**: named plain-text or regex filters with case sensitivity, invert, whole words, exclusions, context lines and a tab color.
- **Per-run-configuration selection**: pick which patterns apply to each run configuration under *Run Settings > Output Filters*.
- **Project-shared patterns**: commit `.qtcreator/multifilteroutput-patterns.json` and the whole team gets them.
- **Live match counts** in every tab label, an **All** tab with the full log and an **Unmatched** tab for whatever no pattern took.
- **Click-to-jump** from a filtered line to its context in **All**, and **click-to-open** file references (QML, compiler, Qt Test, sanitizer, Python) in the editor.
- **Continuation-line grouping** keeps stack traces with the error that started them.
- Find, F6 / Shift+F6 match stepping, quick filter, timestamps, synced zoom, copy and save.
- Keeps up with output floods and switches off regexes that are too slow.

The plugin is disabled by default. Enable it in **Help > About Plugins**, restart Qt Creator, then define patterns under **Preferences > MultiFilterOutput > Pattern Library**. A set of starter patterns (errors, warnings, QML messages, assertions, Qt Test failures) is offered on first use.
